en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-46 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said,

“Do not ruin your prayers. Whoever does so will be united with Qarun and Haman. Then it is the right of God to send him into Hell along with the hypocrites. Then woe be to those who do not guard their prayers and do not perform the Prophet’s (a.s.) tradition.”
